title: Choose the owner's visual world
question: The roll assigned Buku Saldo. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Buku Saldo
options.lineage: the bank savings passbook — green-bar paper off a dot-matrix line printer, a running balance that accrues line by line under a teller's stamp
options.thesis: The owner reads one accruing balance: today's earning adds to yesterday's, and the fleet rides as the account header above it.
options.viewport: A stamp-blue cover block over the balance in dot-matrix figures, a five-state fleet strip, then day-by-day rows whose saldo column accrues to a sealed period total.
options.risk: A passbook only shows what was written into it; an outlet that stops reporting leaves a calm, wrong balance.

raised.raise: One control remaps the whole screen live — changing the period re-sorts and re-totals the entire saldo rail at once, never a reload.
Figures locked to an integer grid with no faux-smoothing, so every rupiah lands on the same tabular column.
The construction grid stays visible as armature — the ledger's columns, rules, and totals are shown honestly, never hidden behind cards.

options.label: Peta Alur
options.lineage: the Batanghari river trade chart — outlets as ports hung off one drawn waterway, stock as cargo moving along it
options.thesis: Where the bikes are, drawn as flow: one river with every outlet a port on its bank and stock moving between them.
options.viewport: A chart-paper sheet with the river drawn down the middle, five ports hung on its banks with unit counts, one flagged red, and a single flow line between them.
options.risk: A map is also the direction most runs in this category reach for; it is familiar, and familiar is not the same as finished.

options.label: Jadwal Rak
options.lineage: the 1971 pocket timetable on a light table — raked tinted glass slides on a lit goldenrod bed, every line at one single type size
options.thesis: The day's outlets as raked slides at one type size, where rank is carried by weight and case and every state is a mark in a fixed cell.
materials: mark cells on a tick rail
options.viewport: A lit goldenrod bed with slides raked eleven degrees past, baselines flat, the next-due slide an opaque reversed plate on top and a tick rail down the right.
options.case: Fuses with real discipline: one type size with rank held by weight and a state as a mark in a fixed cell is exactly how an ops list should behave — but the timetable rack is an artifact worn by a fleet screen.
options.risk: One type size can starve hierarchy; on a phone the rake costs width that the counts need.

options.label: Papan Arah
options.lineage: the airport yellow sign system — saturated bands with black humanist type, white pictograms on black squares, arrows locked to the edge they point past
options.thesis: The owner's next decision on one band: what is ahead, how far, and which way — each junction re-signing only what comes next.
materials: white pictograms on black inset squares
options.viewport: Full-yellow bands stacked edge to edge, a monumental figure in each, pictograms on black squares, and the late junction dropped to a black reversed band at the top.
options.case: Fuses clean: a chain of decision points that re-signs only what is ahead is how a fleet-and-earnings question should read, and everyone already knows how to read a sign — but a sign system carries 'where' far better than it carries money.
options.risk: Wayfinding shouts; a screen checked daily at 07:00 may tire of a full-yellow field.

options.label: Rangkaian Musim
options.lineage: the botanical folio — five plates kept at one exact scale and ground, banded on a shared baseline so each stage compares against the last
options.thesis: Each day a plate at the same scale and ground, so one week's rhythm of ramai and sepi is read by comparison, not by memory.
options.viewport: Five cream plates banded on one shared baseline, each an equal-scale accrual figure under an italic day name and a small-caps stage label, the late day plated in scarlet.
options.case: Fuses on clarity: a fixed scale and ground make a week honest and comparable, which a money screen badly needs — but the folio is a naturalist's object, and an owner may not recognise themselves in it.
options.risk: Elegant and slow; equal plates give every day the same visual weight, so a crisis does not outrank a quiet Tuesday.

options.label: Spesimen Variabel
options.lineage: the interactive variable-font specimen — one slider that thickens a whole grid of glyphs under your finger
options.thesis: The balance as a specimen page, remapped live as you drag through the period.
options.viewport: A giant figure filling the screen above a grid of glyphs and a monospace axis readout.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the specimen is a designer's instrument, not an owner's, and a fixed balance shown as a specimen loses its running history.
options.risk: A letterform playground where a ledger belongs.
options.kept: One control remaps the whole screen live — the period selector re-totals the entire rail at once.

options.label: Spesimen Bitmap
options.lineage: the Emigre bitmap type specimen — coarse pixel letterforms set proudly at poster scale, the low resolution itself the aesthetic
options.thesis: The owner's figures as pixel-honest type at poster scale, integers only.
options.viewport: A pixel headline towering over dense justified columns at five sizes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen about type rendering is not a surface for a fleet, and pixel-honest figures would fight the density a ledger needs.
options.risk: Novelty at the size where the balance should be legible.
options.kept: Figures locked to an integer grid with no faux-smoothing — every rupiah on the same tabular column.

options.label: Kisi Crouwel
options.lineage: the Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen — letterforms built cell by cell on a construction grid that is left visible
options.thesis: The week's numbers set monumentally on the grid that built them, the grid itself the layout.
options.viewport: A faint blue construction grid across the whole screen with monumental figures standing in its cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the specimen is a poster about type, and an owner reading a balance gains nothing from monumental letterforms on a phone.
options.risk: Monumental type fights density and starves the numbers it frames.
options.kept: The construction grid stays visible as armature — the ledger's columns and totals shown honestly, never hidden behind cards.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The owner dashboard this category ships, executed impeccably: a white ground, KPI cards, one line chart, blue accents.
canonCard.viewport: A white ground with a KPI row, a revenue line chart, and a fleet table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
